## Bio

I am a MD/PhD student at the University of Washington. 
My research interests broadly lie at the intersection of computational biology 
and cancer immunology. 
Currently in my PhD, I am using spatial transcriptomics to 
explore mechanisms of immunotherapy resistance in 
[Merkel cell carcinoma](https://merkelcell.org/). 
I split my time between the [Nghiem](https://pnlab.org/), 
[Setty](https://research.fredhutch.org/setty/en.html), and 
[Newell](https://research.fredhutch.org/newell/en.html) labs.
